human_actions_pending.context: Default `yarn test:e2e` runs only the 34-test default mode (mega-journey + perm-*); `PLAYWRIGHT_LEGACY=1` re-enables the 197-test full suite

decisions.rationale: Avoids `runTeardown('test-')` cross-chain wipes; enables truly parallel-or-sequential placement in the project graph

decisions.decision: Flipped chain — perm-* runs FIRST (no upstream dep), baseV1+mega-journey runs LAST
decisions.rationale: Decouples perm-* from any pre-existing/refactor-in-flight failures in mega-journey while the operator refactors all legacy specs
Defends against the data-setup-baseV1 vs data-teardown-perm-not-located-2e2cg race; both fire after the last perm spec finishes — baseV1 setup defensively clears any lingering perm rows
Operator is mid-refactor of all existing tests; default `yarn test:e2e` should only run the mega-journey chain + the new perm-* family

decisions.decision: Operator amendment A1 — selectElectionAndAdvance with set-only semantics (iterate, toggle to match)
decisions.rationale: Idempotent regardless of page default-selection state; reads cleanly at call site as `selectElectionAndAdvance({optionText: /\[EL1\]/i})` = 'make EL1 the only selected election'

decisions.decision: Operator amendment A2 — drop TEXT_RE, use `[<SYMBOL>] <description>` display-name convention
decisions.rationale: For minimal datasets each entity is uniquely identified by its bracketed symbol; specs match inline via `/\[EL1\]/i` regexes — no shared constants needed

next_action: Continue legacy-chain refactor. Re-enable individual legacy specs by moving them out of the `PLAYWRIGHT_LEGACY` block as they pass the refactor. Or, if all legacy specs are being rebuilt against the perm-*/baseV1 pattern, retire them and remove the PLAYWRIGHT_LEGACY block entirely.
